root.message: What survey issue are you experiencing?

options.label: I am not matched to any surveys

not_loading.message: Survey loading issues are often caused by browser extensions or ad-blockers. Try disabling these and reloading. If the problem persists, please raise a ticket.

terminated.message: Surveys can terminate early if your profile does not match the target criteria mid-survey — this is normal and not an error. Points are not awarded for screened-out surveys. If you believe this was an error, raise a ticket.

no_match.message: Survey matching depends on your profile completion. Go to Profile → About You and fill in all sections to unlock more surveys. New surveys are added regularly.
